description: Hybrid candidate: cover every complete sentence, copy software versions/unit symbols by known spans, exact reviewed terminology memory. Not raw model quality or native approval.

dxf-viewer.fields.resetView.translation_input: Fit the drawing in the viewer

shikaku.fields.faq.1.a.source: No. Each rectangle must contain exactly one number clue.
shikaku.fields.faq.1.a.translation_input: A rectangle cannot contain multiple number clues. Each rectangle must contain exactly one number clue.

voice-changer.fields.faq1a.source: No. Your browser decodes and processes the selected audio locally. UsefulVerse does not receive the recording.
voice-changer.fields.faq1a.translation_input: Your browser decodes and processes the selected audio locally. UsefulVerse does not receive the recording.

voice-changer.fields.faq2a.source: No. This lightweight pitch control changes playback rate, so a lower pitch plays slower and a higher pitch plays faster.
voice-changer.fields.faq2a.translation_input: This pitch control does not preserve playback speed. A lower pitch plays slower. A higher pitch plays faster.

dxf-viewer.faq.0.a.source: No. This tool opens ASCII DXF only. It does not decode DWG or binary DXF.
dxf-viewer.faq.0.a.translation_input: This tool cannot open DWG or binary DXF. It only opens ASCII DXF.

voice-changer.fields.faq3a.source: No. It applies simple audio effects. It does not clone a person, isolate vocals, or turn a voice into another real person.
voice-changer.fields.faq3a.translation_input: This tool cannot clone a person or isolate a vocal track. It cannot turn a voice into another real person. It only applies simple audio effects.

voice-changer.faq.0.a.source: No. Your browser decodes and processes the selected audio locally. UsefulVerse does not receive the recording.
voice-changer.faq.0.a.translation_input: Your browser decodes and processes the selected audio locally. UsefulVerse does not receive the recording.

voice-changer.faq.1.a.source: No. This lightweight pitch control changes playback rate, so a lower pitch plays slower and a higher pitch plays faster.
voice-changer.faq.1.a.translation_input: This pitch control does not preserve playback speed. A lower pitch plays slower. A higher pitch plays faster.

voice-changer.faq.2.a.source: No. It applies simple audio effects. It does not clone a person, isolate vocals, or turn a voice into another real person.
voice-changer.faq.2.a.translation_input: This tool cannot clone a person or isolate a vocal track. It cannot turn a voice into another real person. It only applies simple audio effects.

shikaku.fields.faq.3.a.source: No. Progress is stored only in this browser unless you clear its site data.
shikaku.fields.faq.3.a.translation_input: Progress is not shared with other devices. It is stored only in this browser unless you clear its site data.

voice-changer.description.source: Change pitch, shape radio or deep-voice effects, preview echo, and export processed audio locally. Free, private, and no upload.
voice-changer.description.translation_input: Change the pitch of an audio recording on this device. Apply radio or deep-voice effects. Preview echo and export processed audio locally. This tool is free and private. Your audio is not uploaded.

voice-changer.details.source: Your browser decodes the selected audio, applies Web Audio filters, gain, pitch-rate and optional echo locally, then renders a WAV file for download. No audio is sent to a server.
voice-changer.details.translation_input: Your browser decodes the selected audio locally. It applies Web Audio filters, gain, pitch-rate changes and optional echo. It renders a WAV file for download. No audio is sent to a server.

shikaku.limits.source: Puzzles are made in your browser. A larger grid can take a moment on a slower device. No account or file upload is needed.
shikaku.limits.translation_input: Puzzles are made in your browser. A larger grid can take a moment on a slower device. You do not need an account or a file upload.

dxf-viewer.faq.1.a.source: The viewer draws only the entity types listed in its supported-content section. Other entities are reported by type and count; they are not silently approximated.
dxf-viewer.faq.1.a.translation_input: The viewer draws only the entity types listed in its supported-content section. It reports other entity types and their counts. It does not replace unsupported entities with approximations.

dxf-viewer.fields.licenseNotice.source: This viewer bundles dxf-parser 1.1.2 and loglevel 1.9.2 under the MIT license. The parser runs in a local worker; source and license links are provided here.

translations.es: Este visor incluye dxf-parser 1.1.2 y loglevel 1.9.2 con licencia MIT. El analizador se ejecuta en un proceso local en segundo plano; aquí están los enlaces al código fuente y a las licencias.
